prompt: Create an original 90 second downtempo electronica instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: analog bass, soft breakbeat, electric piano, pluck synth. Style: steady restrained broken beat with wide atmospheric space. Tempo approximately 96 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A calm and atmospheric electronic track featuring synth pads, a gentle arpeggiated melody, and a steady, light electronic beat. It evokes a peaceful and reflective mood.
description.zh: 一首平静、大气的电子音乐，以合成器铺底、柔和的琶音旋律和稳定的轻电子节拍为特色。营造出平和、沉思的氛围。
